question: Does one source-driven welded knee/shank extension from the saved calibrated L0 roots retain prior hip quality, preserve the connected surface, and follow explicit T/K/A source points and radii on actual L2 evaluated surfaces for both cases?

included: experiment-local connected root extension from the former thigh exits through knee and shank
common source, frame, subdivision, and hierarchical automatic-binding pipeline
ordinary-human and approved loose wolf-like humanoid anthropomorphic coarse cases
excluded: complete foot, heel, sole, paw, or whole-body completion
species or gait-specific production geometry contract
detailed fingers, facial animation, fur/render polish, advanced physics, engine integration
publication, push, merge, or production architecture
scope.case_symmetry: Use the same construction and binding formulas for both cases; side mirroring is input data, not a case-specific repair.
scope.anatomy_boundary: A is the anthropomorphic case's provisional posterior ankle endpoint. It does not establish the future raised-heel/foot design.

source_and_shape.root: Load each immutable calibrated L0 root and its matching immutable prior L2 rest mesh from inputs.json.
source_and_shape.former_thigh_exit: Weld into the extension and treat as interior; do not assert prior boundary invariance at the former exit.

section_and_knee_construction.radii_source: Use each side's explicit knee, calf, and ankle radii from inputs.json; do not force anterior/posterior equality.

knee_blend.operator: one explicit shared source-station knee blend
knee_blend.formula_policy: Derive station centers, frames, and cross-sections from T/K/A and declared radii with the same formula on both cases; no harmonic solve and no painted replacement at K.

support_fraction_semantics.meaning: Support fraction governs the incoming and outgoing station influence; it is not an ignored field.

section_and_knee_construction.nominal_station_names: Labels for the declared stations only; formulas use the source-point expressions and the support-fraction semantics above.
section_and_knee_construction.anthro_segment_frame: Build the K-to-A rest frame from the actual angled K-A vector; do not assume a vertical shank.

new_ring_weights.interpretation: Apply the corresponding side's thigh/shank columns; each pair sums to one at every new ring.

binding.stencils: Propagate actual expanded L0-to-L2 subdivision stencils, never dominant-owner labels or a synthetic rest mesh.

hierarchy.rest_frames: Use independent J as hip pose input, J-to-K for the hip/thigh rest frame, and K-to-A for the knee/shank rest frame.
hierarchy.pose_transform: Apply inverse-bind then posed-global transforms in the parent/rest hierarchy.
hierarchy.cross_influences: Hip movement must carry the hierarchical descendants; knee movement must affect the shank/ankle descendants while the explicit source-station transition remains observable.

baseline_poses.label: mirrored 15/15
baseline_poses.meaning: mirrored unilateral right-leg local sagittal pose; both20 supplies the symmetric bilateral case

input_perturbations.rest_geometry: reconstruct the affected left distal source-driven extension; keep J/T/K and the right side unchanged
input_perturbations.expected: left distal station centers, K-A frame, final loop mean, and ankle-port placement respond in the negative-y direction; no centroid-equals-A assertion and no unrelated hip movement
input_perturbations.evaluation: compare against the analytic construction response and predicted loop mean, not merely changed vertex coordinates

input_perturbations.rest_geometry: reconstruct only the internal calf station through the shared source/radius formula; keep centerline J/T/K/A unchanged and leave the open ankle boundary/loop mean unchanged
input_perturbations.expected: actual L2 calf posterior envelope expands in -localF; centerline, ankle boundary, ankle loop mean, hip, and contralateral body remain unchanged
input_perturbations.evaluation: verify signed sectional-envelope response and analytical L2 displacement using fixed source frames and propagated stencils, not merely changed vertex coordinates

input_perturbations.rest_geometry: identical to the unperturbed rest geometry; alter only the independent hip pose input and its rest-frame/pivot calculation
input_perturbations.expected: left hip-pivot pose displacement follows the analytic J change, with hierarchical descendants responding through the hip; rest vertices, source radii, and weights remain unchanged
input_perturbations.evaluation: compare analytic pose response and locality, not merely vertexchanged

asymmetric_section_radii.reason: Different anterior and posterior radii translate the section loop centroid away from its source centerline point.
required_gates: final ankle boundary is coplanar with its source section/frame
translated loop mean matches the analytic L0 placement plus the existing Catmull-Clark open-boundary rule
declared A is meaningful as the source endpoint and lies within the endpoint radial envelope
asymmetric_section_radii.anatomy_plausibility: Keep visual anatomy judgment separate from the geometric section/centroid gates.

hip_regression.comparison: Compare prior/current hip-region surfaces by stencil-support mapping.
hip_regression.original_prefix: Original L0 vertices/faces are preserved as a prefix.
hip_regression.correspondence: Deterministic child-face/corner correspondence maps the old patch to the new patch for actual displacement; old/new vertex IDs are not direct correspondence.
hip_regression.exact_invariance: Identical full stencils identify the far unchanged subset only.
hip_regression.near_exit: Report drift around the now-interior former thigh exit; do not invent a universal tolerance.
hip_regression.inherited_upper: Keep inherited upper-region failures separate from new lower-leg failures.

topology_and_geometry.full_L0_stencil_coverage: mandatory for every expanded L0 vertex used by L2

binding_and_pose.independent_J: must remain observable as a pose input without changing rest geometry in the J perturbation

strain_and_collapse_diagnostics.threshold_status: new coarse safeguards for this staging protocol; not inherited acceptance thresholds from the old experiments

visual_review.fixtures: matched camera, scale, lighting, and framing across prior/current rest and pose outputs
visual_review.initial_geometry_before_binding: may be rendered as a diagnostic, but is not a posed result
visual_review.final_candidate: Main Worker personally reviews actual images for every declared case/pose before any result is reported
visual_review.open_surface_note: Open surfaces and inner walls must not be interpreted as capped solids or global volume evidence.

budget_and_failure_policy.correction_condition: only one evidence-justified shared correction after the initial candidate
budget_and_failure_policy.escalate_if_unconvincing_after_budget: report to Overseer before any further work

preparation_pass.reason: This pass only prepares and reviews the bounded inputs/protocol.

future_authorized_captured_run.authorization: Only after Main review and within the declared experiment budget; no automatic trigger or automatic run.
future_authorized_captured_run.body_generation: permitted only in that captured run and only for this bounded stage
future_authorized_captured_run.geometry_execution: permitted only in that captured run and only for this bounded stage

execution_boundary.current_code_capture: No connected-leg implementation artifact is captured or executed by this preparation; a future run must first capture the exact directly referenced source and runtime.

research_references.use: femur inward tendency, more vertical tibia, and non-uniform calf; qualitative source context only
ankle above heel; supports leaving foot/heel design future and outside this stage
general lower-limb terminology/context; not a measurement source for these inputs

reproduction_status: No launcher, body generation, geometry run, or test suite is authorized in this preparation pass.
